scientific_interpretation.spatial_resolution: Block-level forecast for blocks represented in the production inference matrix.
scientific_interpretation.probability_interpretation: Probabilities are the frozen calibrated model outputs from the production forecast engine.
scientific_interpretation.risk_interpretation: Combined monsoon risk is an operational decision score, not a calibrated probability.
scientific_interpretation.calibration_interpretation: Calibration status is retained explicitly. WARNING/DEGRADED states are not hidden or converted into artificial confidence.
scientific_limitations: This report does not establish causal relationships.
Operational risk scores are not substitutes for calibrated probabilities.
Forecast skill can vary across location, season and atmospheric regime.
Calibration-domain warnings indicate that probability interpretation requires additional monitoring.
The current artifact does not justify retraining or recalibration without an independent out-of-sample calibration dataset.
The system should be interpreted together with official meteorological guidance.
